mapper.select:
SELECT bi.pid AS pid, MAX(r.time) AS time, bi.type AS type,
CASE WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN (SELECT number FROM entry WHERE id = bi.class) WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN (SELECT number FROM extry WHERE id = bi.class) WHEN bi.type = 'swap' THEN (SELECT number FROM swap WHERE id = bi.class) WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN (SELECT number FROM sell WHERE id = bi.class) WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN (SELECT number FROM sre WHERE id = bi.class) WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN (SELECT number FROM buy WHERE id = bi.class) WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN (SELECT number FROM bre WHERE id = bi.class) ELSE '' END AS number,
CASE bi.direction WHEN 0 THEN '减少' WHEN 1 THEN '增加' ELSE '' END AS info, bi.nums AS nums FROM batch_info bi LEFT JOIN record r ON bi.type = r.type AND bi.class = r.source WHERE bi.pid = #{batchDetailQuery.pid}
AND bi.type IN
#{typeValue}
AND r.time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{batchDetailQuery.startTime})
AND r.time <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{batchDetailQuery.endTime})
AND (
(bi.type = 'entry' AND bi.class IN (SELECT id FROM entry WHERE number LIKE #{batchDetailQuery.number})) OR
(bi.type = 'sell' AND bi.class IN (SELECT id FROM sell WHERE number LIKE #{batchDetailQuery.number})) OR
(bi.type = 'buy' AND bi.class IN (SELECT id FROM buy WHERE number LIKE #{batchDetailQuery.number})) OR
(bi.type = 'sre' AND bi.class IN (SELECT id FROM sre WHERE number LIKE #{batchDetailQuery.number})) OR
(bi.type = 'bre' AND bi.class IN (SELECT id FROM bre WHERE number LIKE #{batchDetailQuery.number})) OR
(bi.type = 'swap' AND bi.class IN (SELECT id FROM swap WHERE number LIKE #{batchDetailQuery.number})) )
GROUP BY bi.pid, bi.type, number, bi.direction, bi.nums
ORDER BY time DESC
